sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:44

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:44:1
items.html:
Every “Shok” has three joints, etc., and it follows that the two lower joints of Netzah-Hod of Atik remained, etc.: It has already been explained, the difference between the clothing of the NHY of the upper one as Mochin in the lower one and the lower one’s clothing of the Guf of the upper one. For the clothing of the NHY of the upper one as Mochin in the lower one, or in the son of the lower one, means the NHY of the ten Sefirot of the Rosh, which are those NHY that completed the Rosh of the upper one into ten Sefirot at the time of their inclusion in the coupling of the Rosh of the upper one, as above in the adjacent item. But the lower one’s clothing of the upper one, that is, of the HGT NHY of the Guf of the upper one, is because the lower one is always in one degree with the Guf of the upper one, as above.
And with this you will understand that the two accounts brought here in the name of the ARI do not contradict one another at all. For what he says above, that the NHY of Atik clothe only in the HGT of AA and not at all in the NHY, but that only an illumination comes out from the Yesod of Atik and expands in the NHY, turns upon the discernment of the clothing of the NHY of Atik as Mochin in the HGT of AA, for the sake of the Rosh of AVI, which clothe those HGT, as written above at length. And what he says here, that the NHY of Atik clothe also in the NHY of AA just as in the HGT of AA, so that the upper thirds clothe in the HGT of AA and the middle thirds clothe in the NHY of AA, turns upon the discernment of the lower one’s clothing of the upper one, which certainly clothes it down to its Sium, that is, down to the end of Atzilut, since all the Partzufim of Atzilut end evenly. It follows that even the NHY of the lower one necessarily clothe some part of the NHY of the upper one.
But above, where the discussion is of the discernment of the clothing of the NHY of the upper one by way of Mochin, it is certain that the NHY of Atik are clothed only in the HGT, for the illumination of the Mochin of AVI, which clothe there. But with the NHY of AA, where ZON clothe, the NHY of Atik have no relation to them whatsoever such as to clothe in them for the illumination of Mochin, for the Mochin of ZON come only through the joining of AA and AVI, and there is in them nothing of the discernment of Atik but a mere illumination. And this is what the ARI is precise about above: “the self of the NHY of Atik is in the HGT of AA, etc., and therefore the main of their illumination is in the HGT of AA, to illuminate the Mochin of AVI; and afterward, from the Yesod of Atik, only light came out and expanded in the NHY of AA.” That is, as explained in the adjacent item, that only AVI rise as MAN [Mayin Nukvin] in the Rosh of Atik together with AA, and therefore they take with them the self of the NHY of Atik that were revealed through their inclusion in that coupling; but the coupling of ZON is not made there, but only in AA together with AVI, as above, as will be explained further along.
